question: Are there any critical flaws with this, or is this good enough to implement as a PoC?
actual_verdict: Good enough to build as an offline PoC; no critical offline blocker. Fresh signed reciprocal product/Q1 pair and live/quality qualification remain outstanding.

findings.title: Sidecar replacement across instances
findings.response: Private stable sidecar is not unlinked by this implementation. External replacement is not yet bound to persistent journal identity; do not qualify multi-process live ownership against replacement from this PoC.

findings.title: Decision/dispatch facts are fixture-supplied
findings.response: Typed reducer eligibility is not authenticated durable native decision or dispatch evidence. No live adapter exists; callers cannot promote fixture facts into authority.

findings.title: Reducer refusal exception contract
findings.response: P1 Refused can escape prepare/issue; compatibility intentionally preserves explicit tests. Production integration must normalize or handle both refusal types.

findings.title: Detached public issue
findings.response: Public issue remains intent simulation; supported execute/assess own the live lifecycle and all five native adapters are unavailable.

findings.title: Groom preparation concurrency/crash gap
findings.response: Advice read and command/plan commits retain a crash/concurrency HOLD gap; no replay or synthetic outcome.

findings.title: Fork inheritance of owner descriptor
findings.response: O_CLOEXEC covers exec, not a child that forks without exec. Such children can prolong owner-busy after parent death; no automatic reclaim.

findings.title: Restrictive umask sidecar creation
findings.response: Exact0600 sidecar validation can refuse restrictive-umask creation. This is an availability HOLD, not a permission to chmod existing unknown artifacts.

findings.title: Repeated cancellation fixture
findings.response: Three explicit fixture inputs are deliberately retained with original assertions and archived original files; no shared helper migration in this patch.

findings.title: Nonce validator duplication
findings.response: P3/P2 nonce checks remain duplicated; valid configured contracts match today, drift risk retained.

findings.title: Catalogue and lock-path duplication
findings.response: Operation/phase catalogue and sidecar path reconstruction remain duplicated. Measured quality debt remains unwaived.
